## 本次更新

- 升级至 Bern 0.2.1，并全面改用框架自带的默认骨架图替换手写占位组件与加载转圈，具备 120 ms 防闪烁延迟、列表错峰入场与系统减少动态效果适配。
- 用 Bern 原生浮层工具窗与 `ColorPicker` 重构桌面歌词样式调节界面，支持设置分页与插件商店镜像回退。
- 新增逐曲响度均衡、后台测量与插件 API v2。
- 修复 Android 播放页专辑封面被缩成缩略图尺寸偏小的问题、Windows 退出全屏后标题栏失拖、Windows 播放页歌词/评论/桌面歌词图标状态，以及本地音频包装类型遮蔽标签读取的问题。

## What's new

- Updated to Bern 0.2.1 and replaced hand-written skeleton placeholders and loading spinners with Bern's built-in skeleton system (120 ms anti-flicker delay, staggered list entry, and reduced-motion support).
- Rebuilt desktop lyrics appearance controls with Bern's native floating utility window and `ColorPicker`, along with settings pagination and plugin store mirror fallback.
- Added per-track loudness normalization, background measurement, and plugin API v2.
- Fixed undersized album artwork on Android Now Playing, Windows title bar drag after exiting fullscreen, Windows now-playing lyrics/comments/desktop-lyrics icon states, and local audio wrapper tag reading.
